quarterly_data.quarter: Tokai Carbon Co. annual securities report: FY2025 (03-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 (January-December 2025, annual securities report): net sales JPY 322,960 million (-7.8% year on year), operating profit JPY 25,850 million (+33.3%), ordinary profit JPY 26,312 million (+16.5%) and profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 20,078 million (prior year: loss of JPY 56,485 million), against the initially assumed net sales of JPY 341.0 billion and operating profit of JPY 23.3 billion. Net sales by segment: Carbon Black JPY 147,093 million (-6.2%), Fine Carbon JPY 55,969 million (+3.9%), Smelting & Lining JPY 61,751 million (-4.3%), Graphite Electrodes JPY 37,573 million (-23.0%), Industrial Furnaces and Related Products JPY 10,728 million (-34.1%), Other JPY 9,843 million (+0.4%). Net sales by customer location: America JPY 116,861 million, Japan JPY 70,467 million, Asia JPY 76,605 million, Europe JPY 27,550 million, other regions JPY 31,475 million. No external customer accounts for 10% or more of net sales.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 net sales JPY 322,960 million (-7.8%); operating profit JPY 25,850 million (+33.3%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Tokai Carbon Co. annual securities report: FY2025 (03-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fine Carbon segment, FY2025 (management's analysis): sales volume of its main product, solid SiC focus rings for the memory-semiconductor market, rose year on year, and the acquisition of all shares of US graphite processors KBR, Inc. and MWI, Inc. (made consolidated subsidiaries) added sales; operating profit fell on the slowing power-semiconductor market, intensifying competition in China and higher amortisation of goodwill from the acquisitions. Segment net sales JPY 55,969 million (+3.9%), operating profit JPY 7,704 million (-38.1%); segment production JPY 30,899 million (-45.1%, valued at selling prices). The company reorganised and integrated its US processing subsidiaries (MWI and KBR were merged into Tokai Carbon U.S.A., Inc., renamed Tokai Carbon GS, Inc., on 2026-01-01) and completed its domestic capacity-increase investment, building a production structure able to meet future expansion of the semiconductor market; the SiC power-semiconductor market stayed weak as EV growth slowed.
quarterly_data.figure: Fine Carbon net sales JPY 55,969 million (+3.9%); operating profit JPY 7,704 million (-38.1%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Tokai Carbon Co. annual securities report: FY2025 (03-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Other segments, FY2025 (management's analysis): Carbon Black - sales volume fell as tire makers, its main customers, adjusted production, and the US subsidiary was hit by cheap imported tires from Asia; sales JPY 147,093 million (-6.2%), operating profit JPY 13,135 million (-39.5%); the company bought a carbon black plant in Thailand from Bridgestone Corporation (Thai Tokai Carbon Product Rojana, consolidated from 2025-09-30) and is pushing the relocation of its Thai production site. Smelting & Lining - aluminium-smelter cathode volumes fell on delayed relining demand and continued customer inventory adjustment, but cost cuts and lower depreciation after last year's impairment returned it to an operating profit of JPY 1,503 million (prior year: loss of JPY 13,701 million) on sales of JPY 61,751 million (-4.3%). Graphite Electrodes - production in Japan ended at the Shiga plant and was concentrated at the Hofu plant, and German subsidiary TOKAI ERFTCARBON GmbH was sold and deconsolidated; sales JPY 37,573 million (-23.0%), operating profit JPY 2,389 million (prior year: loss of JPY 3,529 million). Industrial Furnaces and Related Products - capex in its main energy and electronic-component markets stayed stagnant; sales JPY 10,728 million (-34.1%), operating profit JPY 2,268 million (-31.4%). Other - friction materials and lithium-ion battery anode materials (ESS demand weak, some spot demand); segment sales JPY 9,843 million (+0.4%).
quarterly_data.figure: Carbon Black operating profit JPY 13,135 million (-39.5%); Smelting & Lining operating profit JPY 1,503 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Tokai Carbon Co. annual securities report: FY2025 (03-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Vision 2030 (long-term vision published February 2025, restated in the FY2025 annual securities report): the company targets net sales of JPY 500 billion, an EBITDA margin of 20% and ROIC of 12% in 2030. Issues it will address: maximise the effect of the graphite-electrode restructuring; settle a drastic restructuring plan for Smelting & Lining as soon as possible and start it immediately; make the capex essential to Carbon Black's medium- to long-term growth; and in Fine Carbon and Industrial Furnaces, which are expected to grow with the semiconductor market, expand production capacity and develop new applications.
quarterly_data.figure: 2030 targets: net sales JPY 500 billion; EBITDA margin 20%; ROIC 12%

quarterly_data.quarter: Tokai Carbon Co. annual securities report: FY2025 (03-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capex, FY2025 (annual securities report): JPY 36,854 million in total, mainly renewal of production equipment - Carbon Black JPY 19,903 million (mainly Tokai Carbon CB Ltd.), Fine Carbon JPY 6,239 million (mainly the Tanoura plant), Smelting & Lining JPY 3,672 million, Graphite Electrodes JPY 2,861 million, Industrial Furnaces and Related Products JPY 782 million, Other JPY 509 million. Planned Fine Carbon facilities: capacity expansion at the Chigasaki Research Laboratory, JPY 5,400 million in total (JPY 5,282 million already paid), November 2022 to February 2026; production-equipment upgrade at the Tanoura plant (Kumamoto), JPY 5,051 million (JPY 2,425 million paid), February 2025 to June 2028.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 capex JPY 36,854 million; Fine Carbon JPY 6,239 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Tokai Carbon Co. annual securities report: FY2025 (03-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Other planned facilities (annual securities report): Thailand - THAI TOKAI CARBON PRODUCT's new carbon black plant in Rayong, JPY 49,203 million in total (JPY 44,250 million already paid), September 2022 to May 2026; after relocating to it in 2026 the current Sriracha plant is to be retired. Also environmental equipment at Tokai Carbon CB Ltd. (Big Spring, US and others) JPY 1,346 million and an equipment upgrade at Tokai COBEX Polska JPY 2,379 million (both to February 2026).

quarterly_data.quarter: Tokai Carbon Co. annual securities report: FY2025 (03-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D, FY2025 (annual securities report): R&D expenses JPY 4,428 million, carried out mainly by the Fuji, Chigasaki, Chita and Tanoura research laboratories. The company is developing fine carbon and fine ceramics products for energy, semiconductor, electronics and environmental uses, where demand has grown markedly; Tokai Konetsu Kogyo is developing high-performance industrial furnaces and silicon carbide products for electronic components and secondary batteries. Sustainability projects include an industry-government-academia carbon black recycling project and the development and demonstration of a carbon-neutral conductive carbon material to replace carbon nanotubes.
